components.thp_v5: Publication-grade confirmation: 3150 rows, 30 seeds, fixed cohort, A1/A2/A3, 7 horizons, 5 publication policies.
components.phase5_corrected: Primary observable-only privacy/freshness experiment; 30 seeds; publication policy, delay, Top-k, EAS, artifact bytes and local encode time.
components.phase7_corrected: Sensitivity study over event rates, uniform/clustered patterns and timing uncertainty. Full summary CSV was not present in the research branch during freeze assembly; do not claim it is included until separately recovered.

reconciliation_rule: v5 and Phase5 answer different estimands and use different population models. Present them side-by-side; never pool or numerically combine them.
claim_boundaries: Synthetic controlled benchmark; not real-world prevalence.
A1=A2 is a retained null under the declared observable-only model.
A3 includes bounded prior candidate elimination and is not purely status-system leakage.
Phase5 local encoding cost is not Internet/network latency.

Publication aggregation has negligible effect on v5 unconditional THP but increases event-conditional ambiguity; Phase5 separately shows a privacy-freshness-resource trade-off for known lifecycle targets.
